title: Show Up
objective: Complete every round with good effort while practicing quality movement and control.
competency: Finish a structured conditioning lesson from beginning to end.
successStandard: The athlete completes every round while maintaining safe, controlled movement.

coachMessage.headline: Every hero starts at zero.
coachMessage.body: You do not have to be the strongest or the fastest. You only have to take the first step. Heroes are not born. Heroes are built.

followUpQuestions: What will you do better next time?

closingMessage.headline: Mission Complete
closingMessage.body: Today you showed up. Tomorrow we build again.
